label: PROCESS-BLINDED RESTART AFTER INVESTIGATOR PLP EXPOSURE
prior_exposure: Two legacy TARGET_NOTES.csv rows with PLP fields exposed before original identity-region freeze; mandatory bootstrap also contains historical reference facts. No such values used in attribution.

representation.frame_convention: original global hop grid; no candidate regeneration

template: Each exact frozen member pitch and frozen root pitch preserved. Candidate evaluated for member pitch and frozen root separately inside that member exact prior window. Harmonics k*f0 up to 2000 Hz, ±one FFT bin. All harmonics retained; not all required present. Overlap means insufficient harmonic resolution (f0<=2 bin widths); no source classification from overlapping bands.
signature: Mean stem magnitude-squared spectrum over native member activity intersection frozen episode; normalize harmonic-band energy vector. Background equal-duration interval immediately before native member onset. No acoustic onset selection. Observable harmonics exceed uniform spectral-density expectation for their bin count. At least3 observable nonoverlapping bands required.
candidate_features: At preserved FM candidate frame use mean power in previous12 frames and next12 frames excluding center; nonnegative post-pre harmonic-energy vector; target enrichment = union-band positive change fraction / union-bin fraction of 30..2000Hz. Cosine of FM change vector with stem signature and synchronous positive stem change; target onset coherence fraction of observable harmonics with positive change and a positive derivative peak within ±6 frames of center. Temporal coherence is descriptive (23.22ms smoothing), not onset GT. Also store derivative-pattern cosine, harmonic-rank correlation, f0 rise, pre/post vectors and nonsignature-band energy fraction.
classes: Insufficient resolution/energy/observable bands => INSUFFICIENT and UNRESOLVED. Coherent fraction>=.5 and enrichment>=1.5 => PITCH_COHERENT. enrichment<=1 and coherent fraction<.5 => BROADBAND_DOMINATED. Else MIXED. PITCH_COHERENT with signature cosine>=.8 and synchronous stem/FM change cosine>=.8 => BASS_COMPATIBLE; PITCH_COHERENT failing source evidence or MIXED with signature cosine>=.8 => MIXED_SOURCE; BROADBAND_DOMINATED and signature cosine<.8 => NON_BASS_COMPATIBLE; otherwise UNRESOLVED. No composite learned score. These thresholds are prospective descriptive conventions, not validated accuracy thresholds.
episode: Deduplicate exact FM PCM sample only across independent member/root evaluations. >=2 BASS_COMPATIBLE coordinates => MULTIPLE;1 compatible and any distinct MIXED_SOURCE coordinate => UNRESOLVED_ATTRIBUTION;1 otherwise => UNIQUE;0 and any UNRESOLVED or MIXED_SOURCE => UNRESOLVED;else NO. Preserve all competing hypotheses and classifications.
selected_crosscheck: Any BASS_COMPATIBLE FM coordinate within one hop of previous selection => counterpart. Also count earlier/later compatible coordinates separately (nonexclusive). Never replace timestamp.
counterfactual: Compare pitch-coherent candidates before empirical signature/synchronous gates with compatible candidates afterward; descriptive added discrimination only, not accuracy.
prohibitions: No PLP, no model run, no BP/Demucs rerun, no time correction or physical correctness claim.
